plan.name: Explain unavailable reader charts with folded evidence
plan.summary: Complete #963 as one plumbing change confined to dashboard presentation: validated proposals, alternatives and saved drafts with no drawable chart show no image, poster or image link and no chart status, but one concise sentence with grouped concrete/projected counts or measured evidence size and units, the applicable ceiling and view-check outcome, while historical concrete-500 records explicitly need a fresh check and missing views, artifacts and generation failures retain their specific reasons. Put complete literal-escaped identities, both named comparison sources and scopes, qualifications, bounds/configuration, tools and retained records in closed native details immediately beneath each unavailable explanation, keeping rule wording and existing ratification/choice controls available; a proposal comparison is drawable only when both sides and their combined evidence fit, never substituting its candidate poster for an unavailable comparison, and receipts keep the independent final outcome/status separate from a retained comparison, showing only independently drawable images and preserving valid final charts after comparison-only damage. Regenerate presentation decisions, links and identities from validated retained evidence on refresh, restart, recovery and durable saved locators, using the same distinction on public and /act cards, preserving script-free evidence styling/security, bodyless HEAD, representation-specific ETags and exact saved-result downloads without changing evidence authority, payload bytes, ratification identity, verdicts or reader/comparison fingerprints. Intentionally replace existing tests' text-panel-as-chart and visible-provenance expectations with no-image and folded-evidence assertions while preserving all omitted/damaged comparison, companion, topology/report, source/pin/count/tool and tampering refusals, and leave shared statechart/verification rendering and all existing drawable canonical data, Markdown, SVG and animated/still poster bytes unchanged. Update SPEC.md with #963's own ratified-plan citation and governing decisions, docs/statecharts.md, docs/dashboard.md and the README's short reader/comparison description (under 400 lines), add the full limit/side/final-outcome, cache, literal-escaping and public/private browser regression matrix including 24,760 concrete states with a fitting projection and two fitting large projections plus pre-change drawable byte/fingerprint goldens, and run decisions check, relevant dashboard/statechart/receipt/verification and browser checks, go vet, the prescribed sharded unit suite and applicable integration checks, with affected real-tool CI checks remaining required rather than merger work.

tests.name: TestReader963ProjectedProposal
tests.says: A validated proposal with 24,760 concrete states and 3,100 projected states has one readable reason and closed complete evidence directly below it, no image or image URL, unchanged evidence, and secure GET/HEAD/ETag responses.

tests.name: TestReader963LimitReasons
tests.says: Concrete projection ceilings, evidence-volume ceilings before and after view checks, and historical concrete-500 records have distinct honest sentences and folded provenance, never invented projected counts.

tests.name: TestReader963LimitedComparisonSides
tests.says: Baseline-only, candidate-only and both-side limitations suppress every comparison image and candidate substitute while retaining both named sources, exact identities, bounds, counts and qualifications as literal folded evidence.

tests.name: TestReader963CombinedComparisonVolume
tests.says: Two independently fitting sources whose combined evidence exceeds its budget show a text explanation naming the combined representation and measured limit, retain both checked sources and show no substitute poster.

tests.name: TestReader963PreviewAndSavedQuestions
tests.says: Validated limited alternatives use the same explanation and closed evidence on direct preview and durable saved-question pages, preserving healthy sibling charts, original options, exact downloads and offline restart behavior.

tests.name: TestReader963SavedProposalLifecycle
tests.says: An authenticated saved proposal comparison with a limited baseline and drawable candidate stays text-only across refresh and restart; durable locators, exact JSON downloads, source identity and ratification controls remain intact.

tests.name: TestReader963ReceiptOutcomes
tests.says: Archived receipts distinguish unavailable comparisons from independently drawable final charts and unavailable final outcomes from drawable retained comparisons, preserve closed complete provenance and never show an image when neither is drawable.

tests.name: TestReader963SpecificReaderFailures
tests.says: Missing views, missing archived artifacts and failed reader generation keep their specific safe explanations with closed retained evidence and no invented size or image; comparison-only damage retains a valid final chart and its diagnostic.
